runtime: Node >= 24, TypeScript run directly via native type stripping (no tsx/build step)
rules: All theme outputs (themes/, zed/themes/, colors/) are generated from src/ and committed; never edit them by hand.
Run `pnpm generate && pnpm check` after any change in src/.
Relative imports use explicit .ts extensions; only erasable TypeScript syntax (no enums/namespaces).
Formatting and lint: Biome (single quotes, no semicolons, 2-space indent).
No runtime dependencies; keep devDependencies minimal and pinned.
Zed themes must define every key of Zed's built-in baseline, otherwise One Dark values leak in.
Keep version in package.json and zed/extension.toml in sync.
